issues.title: [WP-0/Decision] Approve the Cotsel release charter and authority baseline
issues.outcome: Approve one bounded release charter that fixes the pilot mode, participants, value limits, user and operator roles, system-of-record boundaries, cloud owner, provider boundaries, data classes, risk posture, and accountable decision rights.
issues.milestone: M0 Base Migration Decision and Boundary Freeze
issues.accountable: Programme Lead and Product and Finance authorities
issues.delivery: Programme Lead and Cotsel engineering lead
issues.acceptance: Engineering Lead, Product authority, and Finance authority

issues.title: [WP-0/Release] Define the immutable release manifest and evidence-index contracts
issues.outcome: Define machine-readable contracts that bind every Cotsel candidate to exact repositories, images, migrations, contract source and address, ABI, chain, provider configuration, redacted config digest, evidence artifacts, approvers, and rollback targets.
issues.milestone: M0 Base Migration Decision and Boundary Freeze
issues.acceptance: Release Owner, Security reviewer, and Operations reviewer

issues.title: [WP-0/Governance] Establish ownership, change control, defect policy, and forecast rules
issues.outcome: Install named ownership, deputies, separation of duty, decision and exception records, defect severity, evidence invalidation, reporting cadence, and dependency-based forecasting without using percentage complete.
issues.milestone: M0 Base Migration Decision and Boundary Freeze
issues.acceptance: Executive sponsor and required control authorities

issues.title: [WP-0/Journeys] Specify the seven authoritative settlement and recovery journeys
issues.outcome: Specify the complete login, funding, staged release, inspection, treasury, reconciliation, and incident journeys with actors, authority boundaries, expected records, failure variants, stop conditions, and recovery ownership.
issues.milestone: M0 Base Migration Decision and Boundary Freeze
issues.delivery: Cotsel, Agroasys, Cotsel-Dash, QA, and Operations owners
issues.acceptance: Product QA, Finance, and Operations authorities

issues.title: [WP-1/Contract] Deploy and verify the pinned current Base Sepolia contract
issues.outcome: Replace stale deployment evidence with one explorer-verified current contract and propagate its exact source, bytecode, ABI, roles, token, start block, and address to every consumer.
issues.milestone: M1 Base Contract Runtime and Deployment
issues.acceptance: Independent Protocol, Security, and Release reviewers

issues.title: [WP-1/Protocol] Require buyer-signed inspection acceptance and remove Oracle bypass
issues.outcome: Ensure no Oracle or service credential can release the final supplier tranche without the buyer authority or governed deadline policy required by the approved settlement contract.
issues.milestone: M1 Base Contract Runtime and Deployment

issues.title: [WP-1/Governance] Add removable administrators, quorum evolution, epochs, and safe unpause
issues.outcome: Make contract authority recoverable after key loss or compromise while retaining rapid pause and preventing unilateral recovery or stale proposal execution.
issues.milestone: M1 Base Contract Runtime and Deployment
issues.acceptance: Independent Security, Protocol, and Finance reviewers

issues.title: [WP-1/Security] Enforce Oracle, treasury, relayer, signer, and admin role separation
issues.outcome: Reject unsafe role overlap before deployment and prove that every sensitive production authority uses the approved identity and custody boundary.
issues.milestone: M1 Base Contract Runtime and Deployment

issues.title: [WP-1/Rollback] Define and rehearse contract-cohort rollback
issues.outcome: Provide a safe rollback model for non-upgradeable contracts with active funds by bounding cohorts, stopping intake, preserving compatibility, and reconciling both addresses.
issues.milestone: M1 Base Contract Runtime and Deployment
issues.delivery: Protocol, Indexer, Reconciliation, and Release engineers

issues.title: [WP-2/Gateway] Persist broadcast identity and recover unknown financial outcomes
issues.outcome: Guarantee that every accepted gateway command retains its intended transaction identity, cannot be retried unsafely, and resolves after timeout or process death without duplicate broadcast.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety
issues.acceptance: Gateway, Finance, and independent failure-test reviewers

issues.title: [WP-2/Signer] Verify every managed-signer response against canonical intent
issues.outcome: Prevent a compromised or misconfigured signer service from returning a valid signature over a transaction that differs from the action Cotsel approved.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety
issues.acceptance: Security authority and independent transaction reviewer

issues.title: [WP-2/Queue] Replace in-process settlement dispatch with durable leased work
issues.outcome: Ensure accepted settlement commands and callbacks survive restart, have one active owner, expose poison and abandoned work, and reach an authoritative result or owned exception.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-2/Oracle] Preserve Oracle broadcast outcomes and exact-byte authentication
issues.outcome: Make Oracle requests cryptographically unambiguous and keep the original transaction outcome durable across retry, process death, exhaustion, and redrive.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-2/Finality] Unify submitted, confirmed, safe, finalized, and unknown states
issues.outcome: Install one finality vocabulary and transition model across gateway, SDK, Oracle, indexer, reconciliation, and treasury so no consumer promotes a weaker state as final truth.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety
issues.delivery: Gateway, SDK, Oracle, Indexer, Reconciliation, and Treasury engineers

issues.title: [WP-2/Custody] Enforce fail-closed production Oracle signer custody
issues.outcome: Ensure production Oracle progression cannot start with raw keys, insecure transport, missing signer authentication, wrong address, unsafe role overlap, or unapproved automation.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-2/Amounts] Remove floating-point settlement amount ingress
issues.outcome: Preserve exact monetary intent through gateway parsing, validation, signing, persistence, and comparison at every approved boundary and fractional limit.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-3/Indexer] Quarantine poison logs and make checkpoints atomic
issues.outcome: Prevent any undecodable, out-of-order, ABI-drifted, or handler-failed financial event from disappearing behind an advanced checkpoint.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-3/Reconciliation] Add chain-derived bidirectional coverage beyond 1,000 trades
issues.outcome: Make reconciliation independently discover missing chain or indexer records, cover the full bounded block and trade range, and report every unresolved gap.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-3/Readiness] Fail indexer startup and readiness on chain or coverage drift
issues.outcome: Prevent the indexer from serving financial projections when chain, code, address, ABI, start block, finality, RPC availability, range, or checkpoint state is unsafe.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-3/Recovery] Lease, monitor, and recover abandoned reconciliation runs
issues.outcome: Ensure a crashed reconciliation run cannot block treasury indefinitely and one safe successor can resume without direct database repair.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-4/Treasury] Ingest only finalized canonical fee evidence and propagate reorgs
issues.outcome: Prevent orphaned or non-canonical events from becoming payout, revenue, export, or external-handoff evidence.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-4/Handoff] Run freshness-gated treasury ingestion and append-only provider state
issues.outcome: Ensure treasury cannot remain stale while green or record CREATED, FAILED, conflicting, or unverified external handoff evidence as completed value movement.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-4/Controls] Make maker-checker transitions atomic and actor-bound
issues.outcome: Ensure concurrent or forged treasury actions cannot bypass separation of duty, overwrite evidence, or attribute a financial transition to an unverified actor.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-4/Data] Enforce canonical monetary allocations and complete treasury exports
issues.outcome: Make every treasury allocation and export exact, complete, bounded to a stable cutoff, and reconcilable to the eligible ledger without silent truncation.
issues.milestone: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety

issues.title: [WP-5/Migrations] Replace runtime schema mutation with versioned migration jobs
issues.outcome: Remove migration authority from long-lived services and provide deterministic, locked, transactional, observable, and rollback-compatible schema evolution.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-5/Database] Add least-privilege indexer and GraphQL roles with restore proof
issues.outcome: Extend database isolation to indexer and reader surfaces, deny runtime DDL and cross-database access, and restore the same grants and forced RLS after recovery.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-5/Recovery] Prove PITR and full financial restore across all seven databases
issues.outcome: Recover service schemas, roles, forced RLS, sessions, idempotency, financial records, indexer state, schedules, and configuration into a clean environment within approved RPO and RTO.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-6/Images] Build, harden, scan, sign, and publish every Cotsel service image
issues.outcome: Prove each service image builds from a clean context, contains every required workspace input, runs non-root, starts with the complete stack, and maps immutably to reviewed source.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-6/Supply Chain] Enforce pinned actions, scans, SBOM, provenance, and signatures
issues.outcome: Make every dependency, action, image, toolchain, and IaC input attributable and policy-gated without weakening the existing frozen-lockfile controls.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-6/CI] Make the release aggregate complete, required, and meta-tested
issues.outcome: Ensure a release gate cannot be green while any critical workspace, recovery, contract, shared-package, image, or cross-repository check is failed, skipped incorrectly, stale, or administratively absent.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: Release, service, data, and integration owners

issues.title: [WP-6/Governance] Protect sensitive paths with independent review and audited bypass
issues.outcome: Require the correct independent reviewers for contract, treasury, authentication, migration, and workflow changes and make every emergency bypass visible and reviewable.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-6/Docs] Correct active runbooks, commands, links, ownership, and issue metadata
issues.outcome: Ensure an operator or engineer can execute the current release and recovery procedures without obsolete package commands, duplicated links, stale states, or unowned instructions.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-7/Platform] Provision one production-like Cotsel staging platform from reviewed IaC
issues.outcome: Create a reproducible private Base Sepolia runtime with managed dependencies, immutable deployment, protected approval, release identity, capacity policy, and tested rollback in the approved Agroasys cloud control plane.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: Agroasys platform and Cotsel service owners

issues.title: [WP-7/Network] Enforce private ingress, origin denial, and managed HA dependencies
issues.outcome: Expose only approved Cotsel ingress while keeping databases, cache, workers, signers, Oracle internals, indexer internals, reconciliation, and administrative RPC private and resilient.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-7/Configuration] Parse configuration deterministically and forbid disabled production auth
issues.outcome: Make the production profile fail closed on unknown, duplicated, inherited, insecure, cross-environment, or unauthenticated configuration and publish a safe reviewed config identity.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-7/Readiness] Separate liveness from financial dependency readiness
issues.outcome: Prevent promotion or traffic when Cotsel is alive but cannot safely reach required databases, queues, RPCs, signers, indexer state, provider state, or contract identity.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-8/Observability] Deploy privacy-safe settlement telemetry, dashboards, SLOs, and synthetics
issues.outcome: Provide authoritative, redacted, release-bound visibility across gateway, Oracle, relayer, indexer, reconciliation, treasury, dependencies, and end-to-end settlement correlation.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-8/Incident] Deliver durable critical alerts to named on-call owners
issues.outcome: Ensure every critical financial, signer, queue, indexer, reconciliation, treasury, provider, security, and platform condition reaches an accountable primary or deputy and survives outage and restart.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-8/Evidence] Implement immutable release and pilot evidence custody
issues.outcome: Retain fresh signed manifests, test reports, traces, logs, scans, deployment records, chain references, decisions, exceptions, drills, and approver identities outside developer workstations.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness

issues.title: [WP-8/Drills] Rehearse incident, rollback, drift, signer, provider, and recovery runbooks
issues.outcome: Prove operators can detect, contain, investigate, reconcile, communicate, recover, and safely resume after every material failure without unowned action or unresolved financial drift.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: All service, platform, security, finance, and support owners
issues.acceptance: Operations Lead, Finance, and Incident Commander

issues.title: [WP-9/Integration] Require hosted M3 compatibility for the pinned cross-repository release
issues.outcome: Make hosted compatibility verify the exact Agroasys backend, platform.v1, Cotsel-Dash, Cotsel, contract, ABI, route, callback, and provider contracts in the candidate manifest.
issues.milestone: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity
issues.delivery: Cotsel, Agroasys backend, platform.v1, and Cotsel-Dash owners

issues.title: [WP-9/Auth] Make Cotsel session refresh atomic, hashed, private, and lifetime-bound
issues.outcome: Preserve Agroasys identity authority while ensuring Cotsel session creation, refresh, revocation, storage, logging, and expiry cannot leave reusable or excessive credentials.
issues.milestone: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity
issues.delivery: Cotsel auth and Agroasys backend owners

issues.title: [WP-9/Authority] Enforce role ceilings and explicit privileged grants in session exchange
issues.outcome: Prevent any normal trusted exchange key from creating or widening administrator, Oracle, treasury, governance, replay, or signing authority across tenants or environments.
issues.milestone: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity
issues.delivery: Cotsel auth and Agroasys identity owners

issues.title: [WP-9/Ricardian] Enforce tenant authorization on complete document retrieval
issues.outcome: Keep generic verification minimal while preventing cross-tenant access to complete canonical terms, metadata, and evidence through Ricardian lookup.
issues.milestone: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity

issues.title: [WP-9/Journeys] Prove login, funding, stage release, and inspection across deployed repositories
issues.outcome: Execute the approved login, wallet and order funding, stage 1 release, and inspection or final release journeys against one deployed candidate without local mocks or optimistic user-visible finality.
issues.milestone: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity
issues.delivery: Agroasys frontend, backend, Cotsel, and Cotsel-Dash owners
issues.acceptance: Integration Lead, Product QA, and Finance reviewer

issues.title: [WP-9/Journeys] Prove treasury handoff, reconciliation recovery, and incident containment
issues.outcome: Execute the treasury claim and handoff, index and reconcile and recover, and incident containment journeys through the deployed chain, provider, operator, and support boundaries.
issues.milestone: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity
issues.delivery: Cotsel, Cotsel-Dash, Agroasys backend, provider, and support owners
issues.acceptance: Product QA, Finance, Data, and Operations reviewers

issues.title: [WP-10/Controls] Approve privacy, compliance, provider, evidence, and financial-control assurance
issues.outcome: Translate the approved jurisdictions, participant classes, value model, provider duties, data controls, retention, privacy rights, financial authority, and incident obligations into tested technical controls.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.accountable: Security, Compliance, Privacy, and Finance authorities
issues.delivery: Service, platform, provider, and operations owners
issues.acceptance: Compliance, Privacy, Finance, and Legal authorities

issues.title: [WP-10/Assurance] Complete independent contract, application, cloud, and financial-workflow review
issues.outcome: Obtain independent assurance against the stable candidate and close or formally reject every critical or high contract, API, signer, cloud, supply-chain, privacy, and financial abuse-path finding.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: Independent assessors and affected service owners

issues.title: [WP-10/Security] Return stable public errors without internal or provider disclosure
issues.outcome: Give clients safe stable error codes and correlation identifiers while preventing SQL, RPC, signer, provider, Oracle, Ricardian, stack, URL, query, or secret disclosure.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: Gateway, Oracle, Ricardian, and provider-adapter engineers

issues.title: [WP-11/Pilot] Approve participant allowlist, consent, training, caps, support, and stop conditions
issues.outcome: Bind the controlled pilot to named eligible participants, approved jurisdictions, informed consent, trained operators, value and volume caps, staffed support, and explicit stop authority.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: Product, Compliance, Operations, Support, and Finance owners
issues.acceptance: Pilot Owner, Product, and Compliance authorities

issues.title: [WP-11/Rehearsal] Run zero-value and bounded-value pilot lifecycles with daily reconciliation
issues.outcome: Execute supervised end-to-end lifecycles, stop conditions, support, incident handling, and recovery first at zero value and then within approved bounded value while retaining fresh evidence.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: All journey, provider, support, finance, and incident owners

issues.title: [WP-11/Authorization] Record controlled-pilot GO, operation, closeout, and expansion decisions
issues.outcome: Authorize only the exact release, contract, window, participants, limits, owners, evidence, support model, and rollback target, then require a new decision before expansion.
issues.milestone: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
issues.delivery: Programme, release, operations, finance, and support owners
issues.acceptance: Engineering, Operations, Treasury, Incident Commander, and Compliance authorities

issues.title: [WP-12/Decision] Approve the separate Base mainnet product and governance change record
issues.outcome: Open a distinct mainnet programme only after successful pilot closeout and approve its participant, value, jurisdiction, contract, governance, provider, treasury, incident, evidence, and rollback boundaries.
issues.milestone: M5 Base Mainnet Launch and Polkadot Retirement
issues.delivery: Engineering, Operations, Treasury, Product, and Compliance owners
issues.acceptance: Executive launch authority and four required operational roles

issues.title: [WP-12/Release] Deploy the audited mainnet contract and protected application release
issues.outcome: Deploy a separate verified Base mainnet contract and immutable protected application candidate with exact source, bytecode, roles, USDC, schema, config, infrastructure, and rollback identity.
issues.milestone: M5 Base Mainnet Launch and Polkadot Retirement
issues.delivery: Protocol, platform, data, release, and service owners
issues.acceptance: Protocol, Security, Platform, and Release reviewers

issues.title: [WP-12/Operations] Prove mainnet treasury, signer, RPC, capacity, canary, and rollback safety
issues.outcome: Prove live-money operations can fund, sign, submit, observe, reconcile, freeze, recover, roll back by cohort, and close provider or treasury exposure under mainnet load and outage.
issues.milestone: M5 Base Mainnet Launch and Polkadot Retirement
issues.delivery: Platform, signer, RPC, treasury, provider, incident, and support owners
issues.acceptance: Operations Lead, Treasury Owner, and Incident Commander

issues.title: [WP-12/Authorization] Complete mainnet assurance and record four-role explicit GO
issues.outcome: Close the independent contract, application, cloud, and compliance reviews and record explicit mainnet GO from Engineering, Operations, Treasury, and the Incident Commander for the exact window.
issues.milestone: M5 Base Mainnet Launch and Polkadot Retirement
issues.acceptance: Engineering Lead, Operations Lead, Treasury Owner, and Incident Commander
